content.title: Las Vegas parade honors Bruno Mars with street renaming, key to city
content.text: LAS VEGAS (FOX5) — Las Vegas honored Bruno Mars with a parade down the Las Vegas Strip ahead of the kickoff of his highly anticipated tour at Allegiant Stadium.Las Vegas honored Bruno Mars with a parade down the Las Vegas Strip ahead of the kickoff of his highly anticipated tour at Allegiant Stadium.The procession took place on Friday on the north side of Bellagio on Las Vegas Boulevard, traveling past the Fountains of Bellagio, The Cosmopolitan, ARIA and Park MGM before arriving at Toshiba Plaza in front of T-Mobile Arena around 1:30 p.m. Bruno’s arrival at Toshiba was met by Governor Lombardo, who presented him with Nevada’s state flag, key to the city and a proclamation.Autoplay1 of 20Photos from Bruno Mars Las Vegas Strip Parade on April 10, 2026(KVVU)EN ESPAÑOL: Bruno Mars será honrado con desfile en el Strip de Las Vegas y el nombre de una callePark Avenue was renamed Bruno Mars Drive, placing the 16-time GRAMMY-winning artist among a short list of performers recognized along the notable Las Vegas Blvd.Bruno Mars to be honored with Las Vegas Strip parade, street renaming(KVVU)MORE ON FOX5 | Bruno Mars brings Hello Kitty collab to Las Vegas pop-up during tour stopThe event highlighted Mars’ long ties to Las Vegas, including his residency at Dolby Live at Park MGM, and serves as a kickoff for his upcoming world tour, officials say.Commissioner Jim Gibson of the Clark County Commission explained how Mars has been a long-time ambassador for the Valley. “Loving Las Vegas and really wanting a relationship with Las Vegas changes everything. For us, we’re recognizing that. There are only a few entertainers whose names are on our streets. Elvis, Frank Sinatra, Dean Martin, Sammy Davis Jr., Bruno Mars,” Gibson said. Copyright 2026 KVVU.
